gs-EQWI.title: Landscape: wide valley, light snow on peaks
gs-EQWI.summary: A wide open valley with lightly snow-capped mountains, on the west side of the island.

gs-IQU2.title: Houses: white painted wooden church
gs-IQU2.summary: A church and another building made of white-painted wood in the same abandoned town.

gs-J8Iq.title: Coverage: boat trekker, red jacket, ship
gs-J8Iq.summary: A boat trekker in a bay, recognised by a man in a red jacket and an expedition cruise ship behind.

gs-UmHL.title: Landscape: wooden walkway, many seals
gs-UmHL.summary: A wooden walkway, lush green plants and numerous seals on a small island.

gs-XCwP.title: Landmark: abandoned rusted machinery
gs-XCwP.summary: Rusted machinery in an abandoned whaling town. It is the only pinpointable trekker here, so it appears in pinpointable maps.

gs-qYel.title: Coverage: few Gen 3 trekkers, remote isles
gs-qYel.summary: A British territory east of the Falkland Islands, counted as the UK for streaks. A couple of Gen 3 trekkers: one in an abandoned town and three in isolated fjords, none on roads, so just memorise them.
